summary: Candidate is a distinct safety_rule addressing ThreadPoolExecutor deadlock prevention at task design stage. It does not semantically overlap with existing skills (Virtual WAN routing, Maven repository security) or peer candidates (which address exception handling and recovery after failures, not prevention). The candidate operates at task_design_and_submission stage with preventive constraints, while peer candidates operate at execution_monitoring stage with reactive exception handling. No merge, split, or revision relationship exists.
